gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-jost: Pixelify Sans lands with a bold, expressive punch. Jost, a plain sans with broad gaps at its terminals and one unit-width stroke, gives that punch plenty of quiet room.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-jura: Pixelify Sans leads with a bent-paperclip c and plenty of nerve. Jura, a sans drawn in strokes as constant as bent wire, lets its s curves open wide at both ends.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kanchenjunga: Pixelify Sans brings a bold, expressive voice with a steady line. Kanchenjunga, a sans whose shapes never clog at low resolution, backs it up with the steady line of a drafting pen.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kodchasan: Expressive in spirit, Pixelify Sans keeps an unvarying line and a c bent open like a paperclip. Kodchasan, a plain sans whose terminals hang open without calligraphic thinning, is the quieter half.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kosugi-maru: Pixelify Sans hits hard, bold and expressive with a bent-paperclip c. Kosugi Maru, a sans of neon-tube letters with stroke ends set far apart, would carry text along in one steady glow.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kumbh-sans: Pixelify Sans hits with a bold, expressive punch, its unvarying line weight and bent-paperclip c hard to ignore. Kumbh Sans trims its terminals; the heading earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-livvic: Pixelify Sans is all bold, expressive attitude and unvarying line. Livvic, a sans-serif with unstressed curves and a generous c, would lose that attitude if the heading were made small.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-lunasima: Pixelify Sans has a bent-paperclip c and a bold, expressive streak. Lunasima, a sans-serif whose c tips never creep toward touching, leaves the heading to earn its keep big and short.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-m-plus-2: Pixelify Sans is bold and expressive, its line weight never wavering. And M PLUS 2, a sans with a gaping c and one fixed nib width, gives it an approachable partner.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-m-plus-code-lati: M PLUS Code Latin bends neon tubing into letters of constant thickness, each c with the wide mouth of a pitcher. Beside Pixelify Sans, text would glide along friendly and clear.
